headline: On November 7, 1996: NASA launches Mars Global Surveyor
captionCards: Launched on November 7, 1996, from Cape Canaveral
Provided high-resolution maps that guided later Mars missions
instagramCaption:
NASA launched the Mars Global Surveyor on November 7, 1996.


The spacecraft began orbiting Mars to map its surface and study its atmosphere. It was part of NASA’s Science mission directorate, which oversees space science missions. The probe operated for over a decade, returning detailed images and data. Its long-term success helped shape future Mars exploration efforts.
